notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
After 2.5 years of development, it was decided to take a step forward and release [i]Robosoul: From the Depths of Pax-Animi[/i] to the public via Early Access!

We are happy to share, what we believe is a great game, with gamers, fans and friends around the world.

Let us know what you think and help us shape [i]Robosoul: From the Depths of Pax-Animi[/i] to the best game it can be!

In case you ever have a problem, suggestion or an idea for the game, meet us in the discussion board of the game here at Steam.

Hope to see you there ;)

Bastian
